data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'nafahah' which means 'to give delight, pleasure or to be delightful'. In Islamic tradition, it represents the joy and happiness that comes from following the teachings of Allah. The name Nafia carries the meaning “Delight, pleasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nafia usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
